title: Avatar Ik Joint Mapping | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our Avatars in CLO 2025.0 allows you to streamline IK joint mapping for various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars.
Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

02:04 Creating IK Joints
05:00 Adding In Poses & Motion
